Game Overview

In Car Defender, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your strategic prowess in Car Defender, where merging and upgrading a fleet of cars is your key to survival. Engage in fierce battles, unlock powerful vehicles, and use power-ups to crush challenging bosses. Its addictive one-tap gameplay keeps you coming back for endless upgrades.
